default_creds.context: default MinIO console / root credential; confirm REJECTED as an auth-posture check, do not replay to read buckets

misconfig_patterns: A bucket carrying an anonymous (Principal:*) download/readwrite policy (set via `mc anonymous set`) serves GET /{bucket}/?list-type=2 (S3 ListObjectsV2) as a full unauth object listing — every model/dataset/snapshot key
GET / (ListBuckets) is almost never anonymous (needs s3:ListAllMyBuckets on Principal:*) but probe to confirm
POST /minio/bootstrap/v1/verify on cluster deployments < RELEASE.2023-03-20T20-16-18Z leaks all MINIO_* env vars incl MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD/MINIO_SECRET_KEY (CVE-2023-28432)

AI-scope discriminator: in-scope ONLY if the anonymous listing shows AI/ML artifact layout, confirmed from <Key> names (names-only, no download): (1) DVC remote — keys under files/md5/<2hex>/<30hex> or .dvc//cache/; (2) MLflow artifact store — <experiment_id>/<run_id>/artifacts/model/MLmodel, conda.yaml, model.pkl, requirements.txt; (3) raw weights — .safetensors, .gguf, .bin, .onnx, .ckpt, pytorch_model.bin, model.pt; (4) vector/index segments — .lance, segment_*, *.snapshot, collections/; (5) training data — .parquet, .tfrecord, webdataset .tar shards. Generic DB dumps (.sql/.bak/Veeam/restic chunks) or website assets = plain substrate, OUT of scope.

Restraint: names and metadata are the finding. List object KEYS, read HEAD/Range:bytes=0-0 metadata (size, mtime, content-type) to prove an artifact is a model/dataset/vector segment, and stop. Downloading any object body is exfiltration of model weights/training data/PII, forbidden. PUT/POST/DELETE (mc cp, restore, CVE-2023-28434 object-injection, CVE-2024-24747 binary replace) are write/RCE primitives, out of bounds. CVE-2023-28432-leaked creds are evidence of the leak; do NOT replay them. A bucket that 403s or a console login = 'surface open, access not exercised'.

response_markers: x-minio-deployment-id response header (UUID; MinIO-unique, pins live server)
x-amz-request-id + x-amz-bucket-region on an S3-style response
<ListBucketResult xmlns="http://s3.amazonaws.com/doc/2006-03-01/"> with <Key> children = anonymous object listing live
AccessDenied.../{bucket} = MinIO present but bucket not anonymous
CVE-2023-28432: POST /minio/bootstrap/v1/verify 200 body containing MinioEnv, MinioPlatform, MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD, MINIO_SECRET_KEY
Console SPA on :9001/:9090 with title 'MinIO Console' and /api/v1/login XHR
active_probe.false_positive_check: Generic AWS S3 / S3-compatible stores (Ceph RGW, Garage, SeaweedFS, Wasabi) ALSO return <ListBucketResult> XML and x-amz-* headers — require the literal `Server: MinIO` banner or `x-minio-deployment-id` header to exclude them. Reverse proxies / LBot catch-all decoys can echo a fake 'Server: MinIO' — verify with a SECOND signal (x-minio-deployment-id real UUID + MinIO's exact <Error><Code> XML schema; a host that 200s a random path /zzzz is a decoy). Port 9000 is also Prometheus pushgateway, Portainer agent, SonarQube — require the S3/MinIO header set. A 403 AccessDenied or console login = 'surface open, access not exercised', not an unauth finding. Empty <ListBucketResult> (no <Key>) = anonymous policy on an empty bucket, out of scope.

deployment_tells: Server: MinIO + x-minio-deployment-id (UUID) response headers on :9000 pin a live server
XML with children = anonymous object listing live; AccessDenied = present but not anonymous
MinIO Console SPA on :9001/:9090 with /api/v1/login XHR
pivot_paths: GET /{bucket}/?list-type=2 -> read <ListBucketResult>, capture <Key> NAMES ONLY to map the artifact tree (DVC/MLflow/weights/vector segments)
GET /{bucket}/?prefix=<dir>/&delimiter=/ -> walk folder structure via <CommonPrefixes> without enumerating every object (low-noise tree map)
HEAD /{bucket}/{key} -> read Content-Length / Last-Modified / ETag / Content-Type of a single artifact to confirm a real model/dataset blob (size + mtime), zero bytes downloaded
GET /{bucket}/.dvc/config or /{bucket}/<run>/artifacts/model/MLmodel as a HEAD/Range:bytes=0-0 to confirm tooling WITHOUT pulling the file
POST /minio/bootstrap/v1/verify (only on confirmed < 2023-03-20 builds) -> read leaked env to attribute operator (S3 endpoint URL, region) and pin version; never reuse leaked creds to authenticate
Console :9001 /api/v1/login probe -> confirm default minioadmin:minioadmin is REJECTED (auth posture) without attempting authenticated bucket reads
vulnerabilities: CVE-2023-28432: unauth info disclosure — POST /minio/bootstrap/v1/verify on cluster deployments returns all MINIO_* env vars incl MINIO_ROOT_USER/MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD; fixed RELEASE.2023-03-20T20-16-18Z; actively exploited

CVE-2023-28434: security-feature bypass in PostPolicyBucket — crafted request bypasses metadata bucket-name check to PUT an object into any bucket (needs Console API + arn:aws:s3:::* creds); fixed RELEASE.2023-03-20T20-16-18Z
CVE-2024-24747: MinIO update path lets a privileged user replace the server binary, enabling arbitrary code execution / supply-chain RCE; fixed RELEASE.2024-01-31T20-20-33Z

CVE-2025-62506: IAM session-policy DenyOnly mishandling (isAllowedBySessionPolicy*) — restricted STS/service accounts escalate by minting unrestricted service accounts; fixed 2025-10-15 (c1a49490c78e)
